name: Verify

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

# Cancel superseded runs on the same ref to save CI minutes.
concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  python-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip

      - name: Install ruff
        run: python -m pip install ruff==0.15.22

      - name: Ruff lint
        run: python -m ruff check .

  python-test:
    # Activate only after the dedicated dispatcher and exact workflow hash are approved.
    # Turning this off affects NEW jobs; cancel/rerun queued jobs for hosted fallback.
    runs-on: ${{ vars.OSVOX_LINUX_ISOLATED_RUNNERS == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && fromJSON(format('["self-hosted","Linux","X64","osvox-linux-python","osvox-run-{0}","osvox-attempt-{1}","osvox-python-{2}"]', github.run_id, github.run_attempt, matrix.python-version)) || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install package and dev dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -e ".[dev,mcp]"

      - name: Run Python tests
        # The Claude CLI end-to-end test requires an authenticated external service.
        # Every deterministic unit, contract, org-collab, voice-memory, and retry
        # test runs here.
        run: >-
          python -m pytest tests
          --ignore=tests/test_engine_e2e_claude.py
          -W error::DeprecationWarning
          -q --tb=short

      - name: Verify standalone model archive and small App boundaries
        run: python -m pytest scripts/test_package_model_media.py scripts/test_small_app_bundle.py scripts/test_app_equivalence.py scripts/test_split_model_media.py scripts/test_render_split_media_dmg.py scripts/test_write_app_model_catalog.py scripts/test_prepare_common_asr_app.py -q --tb=short

  typescript-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm

      - name: Install workspace dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Reject high-severity JavaScript advisories
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high

      - name: Build contracts
        run: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts

      - name: Check and test API
        run: |
          npm run check --workspace services/api-ts
          npm run test --workspace services/api-ts

      - name: Check desktop cockpit contracts
        run: npm test --workspace apps/desktop-tauri

      - name: Check, test, and build web console
        run: |
          npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web-console
          npm run test --workspace apps/web-console
          npm run build --workspace apps/web-console

  mobile-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: mobile/voxagent-companion
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "26.5.0"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: mobile/voxagent-companion/package-lock.json

      - name: Set up deterministic candidate builder Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.14.5"

      - name: Verify reviewed verification entry points before execution
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          sha256sum --check <<'PINS'
          30e090a3b656c05ab42028bffd941532fe3b811c145e3afd6fa84a2a5a5ae7de  scripts/prepare_mobile_ci_inputs.py
          84ee16387b24771d2e749c44f3e5746ce580bc0321c416ba754e477e9500dbf6  scripts/prepare_mobile_delivery_fixture.py
          05fdbf710d235143229ec4afabaa912d5580fcd5ca0c27a89f1cc3d30a692a3a  scripts/verify_mobile_canonical_ci.py
          aef9e911b35d601b473abc494861ad63d316aba5d251adcb865e79003ed08e94  scripts/verify_mobile_delivery_install.cjs
          e3e0e6cdecbbc3e9e4b56d5f910e7867cea56f629f895772aa8370952e24438a  security/mobile-candidate/provenance.cjs
          8c1267ce8bc55d27b42ee7fd29fb68c929f0807cc670a32a93f67399b1d7340f  security/mobile-candidate/safety-verifiers.json
          PINS

      - name: Test canonical report acceptance and refusal
        working-directory: .
        run: |
          python3 scripts/test_mobile_canonical_ci.py
          python3 scripts/test_mobile_archive_compression.py

      - name: Pin candidate builder npm
        run: npm install --global npm@11.17.0 --ignore-scripts

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify pinned dependency defenses
        run: npm run security:provenance

      - name: Reject high-severity JavaScript advisories
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high

      - name: Typecheck and test mobile companion
        run: |
          npm run fixtures:check
          npm run typecheck
          npm test

      - name: Prepare pinned offline canonical verification inputs
        working-directory: .
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/prepare_mobile_ci_inputs.py
          --table-sha256 8c1267ce8bc55d27b42ee7fd29fb68c929f0807cc670a32a93f67399b1d7340f
          --output build/qualified-mobile-inputs

      - name: Prepare exact committed target-layout fixture
        working-directory: .
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/prepare_mobile_delivery_fixture.py
          --output build/qualified-mobile-delivery
          --legacy-dir build/qualified-mobile-inputs/legacy

      - name: Verify normal target-layout install lifecycle
        working-directory: build/qualified-mobile-delivery/mobile/voxagent-companion
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify complete explicit canonical contract
        working-directory: .
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/verify_mobile_canonical_ci.py
          --runner-sha256 c204cafd467f4d3aaf966126e77b4d3f69f2561263b056151036ee5afa7c9722
          --node-bin "$(command -v node)"
          --app-root build/qualified-mobile-delivery/mobile/voxagent-companion
          --upstream-dir build/qualified-mobile-inputs
          --oracle-root build/qualified-mobile-inputs/oracle/mobile/voxagent-companion

  windows-tauri-test:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Verify SQLite WAL and Windows file locking
        run: python scripts/verify_windows_sqlite.py --require-windows

      - name: Install Rust stable
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt

      - name: Check canonical Tauri shell
        run: |
          cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop-tauri/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
          cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop-tauri/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked

  rust-advisory-audit:
    name: RustSec advisory audit (pinned)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      CARGO_AUDIT_URL: https://github.com/rustsec/rustsec/releases/download/cargo-audit/v0.22.2/cargo-audit-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-v0.22.2.tgz
      CARGO_AUDIT_SHA256: ab28a1bdb54db4d5d8ad5981cf1f959410370b3d28250dbd35f6a44248620e39
      RUSTSEC_ADVISORY_DB_COMMIT: ef03605143a913024f864d2edf476adad5720c93
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install checksum-pinned cargo-audit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit-bin"
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit.tgz" \
            "$CARGO_AUDIT_URL"
          echo "$CARGO_AUDIT_SHA256  $RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit.tgz" | sha256sum --check
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit.tgz" \
            --strip-components=1 \
            -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit-bin"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/cargo-audit-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Checkout pinned RustSec advisory database
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git init "$RUNNER_TEMP/rustsec-advisory-db"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/rustsec-advisory-db" remote add origin \
            https://github.com/RustSec/advisory-db.git
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/rustsec-advisory-db" fetch --depth 1 origin \
            "$RUSTSEC_ADVISORY_DB_COMMIT"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/rustsec-advisory-db" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD

      - name: Audit canonical Rust lockfiles
        run: >-
          python scripts/rust_audit_gate.py
          --database "$RUNNER_TEMP/rustsec-advisory-db"
          --repo-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

  swift-build:
    # Default-off: enable only after the exact main workflow and dispatcher qualify.
    # PRs keep hosted macOS; a flag change does not retarget already queued jobs.
    runs-on: ${{ vars.OSVOX_MACOS_ISOLATED_RUNNERS == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && fromJSON(format('["self-hosted","macOS","ARM64","osvox-macos-swift","osvox-run-{0}","osvox-attempt-{1}"]', github.run_id, github.run_attempt)) || 'macos-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ vars.OSVOX_MACOS_ISOLATED_RUNNERS == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 20 || 360 }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Select supported Python from pinned isolated image
        if: runner.environment == 'self-hosted'
        run: |
          /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(sys.executable, sys.version); sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 14, 7) and callable(getattr(hashlib, "file_digest", None)) else 1)'
          echo '/opt/homebrew/bin' >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Build Swift
        working-directory: macos
        run: |
          swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors
          swift build -c release -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors

      - name: Verify model manifest and file boundaries
        run: python3 scripts/verify_model_manifest.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
      - name: Verify bounded ASR stdout reader
        run: python3 scripts/verify_asr_port_reader.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
      - name: Verify Debug and Release ASR runtime and model selection
        run: python3 scripts/verify_asr_exit.py --launch-policy --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
      - name: Verify ASR actor exit generations
        run: python3 scripts/verify_asr_exit.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
      - name: Verify offline model media and import bridge
        run: |
          python3 scripts/build_model_import_cli.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
          python3 scripts/verify_model_import_cli.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
          python3 scripts/verify_offline_model_import.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"
          python3 scripts/verify_pinned_model_download.py --sdk "$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)"

      - name: Verify input backup receipt recovery and identity isolation
        run: python3 scripts/verify_input_backup_client.py --sdk "$(xcrun --show-sdk-path)"
      - name: Verify private Context consumer and revision invalidation
        run: python3 scripts/verify_context_private_inbox.py --sdk "$(xcrun --show-sdk-path)"

      - name: Verify read-only context Git and worktree inspection
        run: python3 scripts/verify_context_repository.py --sdk "$(xcrun --show-sdk-path)"
